The *Attanipātanapañha* ("On Suicide") is a doctrinal enquiry located within the fifth division of the *Milindapañha*. As reflected in its title, the text examines questions surrounding suicide and taking one's own life, thematic material traditionally related to the narrative context of the *Pāyāsi Sutta* (DN 23) and the monastic regulation governing the destruction of human life in the third *Pārājika* rule of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga*.
